thread.title: Mac Storage Recovery and Google Drive Dedupe
thread.purpose: Recover critical disk space on Troy Latter's Mac, identify high-value duplicate/staging artefacts, and prepare a safe exact-hash dedupe workflow across My Drive and Shared drive T4H1.
scope: Local macOS disk-pressure diagnosis and emergency recovery
Google Drive My Drive and T4H1 duplicate-audit design
Governed closeout and transfer into Pen runtime
thread.display_reference: ChatGPT thread: Mac cleanup, local dedupe, and Google Drive T4H1 dedupe

classification.rationale: Local disk recovery produced receipted improvements and a verified large-file inventory, but the Google Drive dedupe audit has not completed against the correct rclone remote and no Pen runtime submission receipt exists in this execution environment.

evidence.memory_pressure: 48 MiB unused RAM, heavy compression, load averages above 11

completed_work.reason: The script selected rclone remote s3-tech rather than a Google Drive remote, so the run did not inventory My Drive or T4H1 and produced no valid receipt.

assumptions: T4H1 should be treated as canonical for exact duplicate cross-estate files unless a newer verified canonical version exists elsewhere.
The latest July LLM export and current raw JSON sources should be retained until hash-based reconciliation is complete.
Docker.raw apparent size may be sparse and should not be treated as recoverable bytes without Docker readback.

local_folders: /Users/troylatter/Desktop/000A - to be indexed - and left - daily
/Users/troylatter/Desktop/000C - Chat files via LLMs - to be indexed - and left - daily

open_commitments: Run the corrected rclone audit using gdrive-personal or another verified Google Drive remote.
Create exact-hash duplicate manifest across My Drive and Shared drive T4H1.
Execute deletion only for confirmed duplicate candidates with a retained canonical copy.
Submit this canonical envelope through tools/thread_runtime_submit.py using S3 backend and independently read back the stored object.
Record submission ID, idempotency key, content hash, backend, path, and receipt.

blockers.blocker: Mac remains below preferred 10–20 GB free-space operating margin.
blockers.impact: Continued risk of hangs, swap growth, failed sync, and incomplete scans.

Remove caches and rebuildable development folders
Remove selected old LLM exports and matching temporary hard links

recovery_actions.outcome: 49 files identified; major storage drivers isolated

safe_to_archive: Superseded cleanup scripts after receipts are preserved
Old cleanup logs once canonical receipts are copied to S3/GitHub

success_criteria: receipt reports files_inventoried, duplicate_groups, duplicate_objects, recoverable_bytes, deletions_executed=0

Local access to TML-4PM/the-pen checkout or equivalent execution plane

whole_of_life_business_assessment.business: Local storage pressure threatens T4H operational continuity, evidence handling, and delivery velocity.
whole_of_life_business_assessment.customer: No customer production systems were changed, but workstation instability could delay customer-facing delivery.
whole_of_life_business_assessment.family: No direct family data was changed; instability could affect availability and personal continuity.
whole_of_life_business_assessment.financial: Uncontrolled duplicate storage and local VM/model growth create avoidable time and infrastructure costs; accidental deletion could also impair tax-audit evidence.
whole_of_life_business_assessment.human: Repeated hangs and emergency cleanup impose cognitive load and operational stress.
whole_of_life_business_assessment.legal: R&D tax and audit evidence must not be deduplicated by filename alone; exact-hash and canonical-copy controls are required.
whole_of_life_business_assessment.operational: The process improved from broad recursive scans to bounded, receipt-driven deletion and exact-hash audit design.
whole_of_life_business_assessment.personal: The Mac is a critical working surface and was operating at severe disk and memory pressure, creating risk of data loss, interrupted work, and degraded day-to-day productivity.
whole_of_life_business_assessment.product: Docker, Claude VM, LM Studio, and migration staging artefacts are significant local storage consumers and need lifecycle policies.
whole_of_life_business_assessment.reputational: Loss of audit or research evidence would damage trust; overclaiming cleanup or dedupe completion is prohibited.
whole_of_life_business_assessment.research: LLM exports and research artefacts are high-value source evidence; retention and canonical placement must precede deletion.
whole_of_life_business_assessment.societal: Research and evidence assets may support broader human and societal initiatives; preservation quality matters.
whole_of_life_business_assessment.strategic: T4H needs automated storage lifecycle, canonical evidence placement, and periodic Drive dedupe controls.
whole_of_life_business_assessment.technical: Primary risks are APFS pressure, sparse disk images, duplicated migration staging, incomplete cloud downloads, and incorrect remote selection.

black_spots: Whole-home recursive scans under critical disk pressure
Selecting the first rclone remote without type validation
dark_spots: Sparse Docker image mistaken for fully reclaimable physical storage
Cloud-only Drive files being hydrated during local hashing
Audit evidence deleted before canonical S3/GitHub reconstruction proof
risks: False REAL claims without runtime readback
